column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule overrides. Columns: rule id, action (IGNORE, WARN, FAIL), reason.
# Everything not listed keeps ZAP's default. Any FAIL breaks the build.

column3: Content Security Policy header must be present
HSTS is checked by pytest; this scan runs over plain HTTP inside CI where browsers ignore it
Server header must not leak version information
Anti-CSRF tokens: the form is protected with Fetch Metadata (Sec-Fetch-Site) and has no session to ride; covered by tests/security/test_browser_defences.py
Storable and cacheable content: informational; static assets are intentionally cacheable
